verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party AI that generates or improves prompts, flows, or test cases from a description. Pipecat instead supplies building blocks for external coding agents: context-hub registers as an MCP server for the user's own coding agent, and scaffolding writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Evals require the user to describe conversations themselves, and Flows' metadata auto-derivation is deterministic signature parsing, so neither counts as AI-assisted authoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description

citations.quote: pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index
